Step 1 of 3 — Set the portal password
Needed only if you want the device's web portal on your network.
Finishing reboots the device into normal mode. To reconnect afterwards: hold the device button during the splash screen to enter portal mode (BLE is always on there), then Scan & Connect.

If the device is not found: hold its button during the splash screen to enter portal mode, then tap Scan & Connect. After you authenticate, enable “Start Bluetooth automatically on unlock” in Settings so the radio starts on every unlock.
Not signed in — connect and sign in from the Settings tab to see your codes.
Long-press an entry to edit or delete.
Not signed in — connect and sign in from the Settings tab to see your passwords.
Pulls a read-only copy of your vault onto this phone. No device connection needed.
Read-only copy from the server. Tap a code to view it, tap a password entry to view it.
Not signed in — connect and sign in from the Settings tab to back up or restore.
